setup: Use a Codex parent running gpt-6-astra unless a scenario specifies another host. Copy listed fixture paths preserving their hierarchy into an isolated workspace. Supply the whole skill folder and native sub-agent tools. Record host, parent model, actual worker models/efforts, prompts, completed reports, evidence checks and failures in harness_report.json. Never infer a model from its task name.

evals.name: protocol-corpus-inventory
evals.prompt: Use astra-orchestrator to inspect all four plugin packages and inventory every model choice, consultation limit, worker retry policy, and host-specific invocation route. Split the independent Fable and Astra source groups across native readers, verify the package list first, and write PROTOCOL_INVENTORY.md with source pointers and gaps.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-backed inventory from two scoped native readers, with parent synthesis.
assertions: Parent verifies the package list before assigning reading
Workers have explicit lower-tier GPT model and reasoning settings, fresh contexts and scoped briefs
No nested Codex CLI worker processes
Each completed report has evidence pointers and respects the requested length limit
No overlapping full-corpus assignments, recursive worker delegation, or worker edits
Parent resolves material discrepancies and writes PROTOCOL_INVENTORY.md
At most six executed worker interactions including follow-ups; actual models and gaps reported

evals.name: restraint-small-read
evals.prompt: Read ROUTINE.md and tell me what it currently schedules. This is a single-file summary, not a redesign.
evals.expected_output: Short local answer with no worker overhead.
assertions: Zero worker spawns and zero Codex CLI invocations
No escalation into designing or running the routine

evals.name: worker-failure-budget
evals.prompt: Use astra-orchestrator to compare the Fable and Astra advisor rules and report differences with file pointers.
evals.setup: Inject an incomplete report without evidence pointers for one worker, then fail its single retry.
evals.expected_output: Bounded recovery followed by an honest coverage gap or narrow parent check.
assertions: At most one follow-up or retry for the failed brief
No silent model upgrade, Astra reading worker, or unbounded respawn

evals.name: claude-code-boundary
evals.prompt: Use astra-orchestrator to fan out GPT readers over these plugin packages.
evals.expected_output: Explain that this mode requires a Codex parent with native sub-agents.
assertions: No claim that a skill changed the parent into Astra
May explain the Astra advisor CLI route but does not start an unsolicited consult

evals.name: user-solo-override
evals.prompt: Inventory the plugin protocols yourself. Do not delegate or run other model sessions.
assertions: User solo instruction takes precedence over the split gate
